name: 01-initialize
description: Session initialization, advertised agent capabilities, and the session/new response shape, with an empty client capability set.

steps.note: Empty clientCapabilities mirrors what our own production ACP client sends, so the advertised capabilities are directly comparable.

prompt.text: Reply with exactly the word: ack

steps.note: Proves the session is live, so an empty capability advertisement is not mistaken for a dead session.
